text:
anya: Quick thread — shortlist approach for a 6-partner beta focused on Private/Dedicated handoffs. Keep it small and iterative.
miguel: +1. Recommend waves of 2 so we can iterate runbooks after each pair.
priya: Agree. Suggest signals for shortlisting: infra maturity, regulatory need, willingness to share eval logs, and a single POC contact.
dan: For onboarding ops, we need clear provisioning SLAs per wave. Propose: VPC <3 business days, assisted on-prem <7 business days.
anya: Good. Also we should require partners to opt into anonymized telemetry for the 8-week pilot. Tick box on intake.
priya: Draft intake snippet:
```
Company:
Deployment preferred: VPC / on-prem
Avg qps estimate:
Regulatory tags (HIPAA/GDPR/None):
POC (name/email):
Share anonymized logs? Y/N
```
miguel: For success criteria: onboarding time met for 4/6, 95th pctl latency within SLO two weeks running, preflight automation passes for >=3 partners, and partner NPS >=8 at week 6.
dan: Need owners: product owns outreach copy + exec sponsor ask, eng owns runbook + preflight script, CS owns shortlist.
cs-bot: cs-bot: Exported shortlist (12 candidates) to Drive. Recommend prioritizing 8 for initial reach.
anya: Next actions: (1) priya publishes intake + scoring rubric by 1759999200, (2) miguel to draft outreach copy, (3) dan to prototype preflight script POC. I'll coordinate kickoffs once intake is live. :rocket:
